name: research-and-report
notes: Same four-stage article as scenarios/research_team.py for python-history. The other two cases use the same stage shape so CrewAI, LangGraph, and Microsoft Agent Framework can be scored on one set.

cases.plan:
RESEARCH PLAN:
1. Gather key facts and dates
2. Identify the creator and origins
3. Draft the findings
cases.findings: FINDINGS: Python was created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991. Its design emphasizes readability with significant indentation. Python 3 arrived in 2008.
cases.draft: DRAFT ARTICLE: Python, created by Guido van Rossum and released in 1991, is a readable, indentation-based language that grew into one of the world's most popular programming languages.
cases.review: CRITIC REVIEW: APPROVED. The Python article correctly names the creator (Guido van Rossum) and the release year (1991).

cases.plan:
RESEARCH PLAN:
1. Name who introduced the protocol
2. Record the organisation and the year
3. Draft the findings
cases.findings: FINDINGS: HTTP was introduced by Tim Berners-Lee at CERN in 1991 as the application protocol of the World Wide Web.
cases.draft: DRAFT ARTICLE: HTTP, introduced by Tim Berners-Lee at CERN in 1991, is the application protocol that carries the World Wide Web.
cases.review: CRITIC REVIEW: APPROVED. The article names Tim Berners-Lee, CERN, and the year 1991.

cases.plan:
RESEARCH PLAN:
1. Name who proposed the model
2. Record the year of the paper
3. Draft the findings
cases.findings: FINDINGS: The relational model was proposed by Edgar F. Codd in 1970. Data is organised in tables of rows and columns.
cases.draft: DRAFT ARTICLE: The relational database model, proposed by Edgar F. Codd in 1970, stores data in tables of rows and columns.
cases.review: CRITIC REVIEW: APPROVED. The article names Edgar F. Codd and the year 1970.
